talmai-2.about: King living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
talmai-2.note: Caleb drove three Anakim giants out of Hebron, and Talmai was one of them.

tappuah.title: Tappuah
tappuah.note: A town on the line between Ephraim and Manasseh.

tappuah-3.title: Tappuah
tappuah-3.note: Named once, in Joshua, and nowhere else.

taralah.title: Taralah
taralah.note: A town given to Benjamin, in the hill country near Gibeon. Nobody has found the site.

telem-2.title: Telem
telem-2.note: A town on Judah's southern border, in the list at Joshua 15:24. It may be the Telaim where Saul gathered his army against the Amalekites.

timnah.title: Timnah
timnah.note: The Philistine town where Samson saw the woman he wanted to marry. The riddle at that wedding feast started his long fight with the Philistines.

timnah-2.title: Timnah
timnah-2.note: Named once, in Joshua, and nowhere else.

timnath-heres.title: Timnath-heres
timnath-heres.note: The name means portion of the sun. Joshua was given this town in the hill country of Ephraim and was buried there, north of the hill of Gaash. The book of Joshua spells it Timnath-serah.

tirzah.title: Tirzah
tirzah.note: An old Canaanite royal city that served as capital of the northern kingdom before Samaria was built. The Song of Solomon sets its beauty beside Jerusalem's. Menahem seized the throne from there.

tirzah-2.title: Tirzah
tirzah-2.about: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
tirzah-2.note: She was the youngest of Zelophehad's five daughters, named with her sisters each time the family's inheritance comes up.

tyre.title: Tyre
tyre.note: The leading Phoenician port, partly on the mainland and partly on an island offshore, rich from sea trade and purple dye made from murex shells. Its king Hiram sent cedar and craftsmen for David and Solomon. The prophets attacked its pride and said it would fall.

ummah.title: Ummah
ummah.note: One of Asher's towns in Joshua 19:30. Some Greek manuscripts read Acco here, and many scholars prefer that, since Acco is otherwise missing from Asher's list.

zaannannim.title: Zaannannim
zaannannim.note: On Naphtali's border, near Kedesh, by the oak where Heber the Kenite had his tent. Sisera ran there after his army broke at the Kishon, and Heber's wife Jael killed him.

zanoah.title: Zanoah
zanoah.note: A town in Judah. Its people repaired one of Jerusalem's gates when Nehemiah rebuilt the walls.

zanoah-2.title: Zanoah
zanoah-2.note: Named once, in Joshua, and nowhere else.

zaphon.title: Zaphon
zaphon.note: The name means north, and it was a town of Gad in the Jordan Valley. Some scholars find it again in Judges 12:1, where the Ephraimites gather to confront Jephthah. Nobody has located it.

zareah.title: Zareah
zareah.note: Samson's hometown, better known as Zorah, on the border of Judah and Dan. The angel of the Lord told Manoah's wife there that she would have a son, and Samson was buried between Zorah and Eshtaol.

zareth-shahar.title: Zareth-shahar
zareth-shahar.note: Splendor of the dawn. It was a town of Reuben on a hill above the plain by the Dead Sea, usually placed near the mouth of the Wadi Zarqa Ma'in.

zebulun.title: Zebulun
zebulun.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
zebulun.note: Jacob's tenth son and Leah's last. His tribe's land ran up to the Sea of Galilee, and Isaiah names it with Naphtali as the place where a light would dawn, which Matthew applies to Jesus in Galilee.

zelah.title: Zelah
zelah.note: A town of Benjamin, probably Saul's own. David had the bones of Saul and Jonathan brought back and buried there in the tomb of Kish.

zelophehad.title: Zelophehad
zelophehad.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
zelophehad.note: He died in the wilderness with five daughters and no sons. They went to Moses and asked for their father's land, and they got it, and the law of inheritance changed because of them.

zemaraim.title: Zemaraim
zemaraim.note: Two places. One is a town of Benjamin, generally put at a ruin north of Jericho. The other is a hill in Ephraim where Abijah of Judah beat Jeroboam's much bigger army.

zenan.title: Zenan
zenan.note: A lowland town of Judah. Micah probably means the same place when he says Zaanan's people will not come out, and nobody has found the site.

zer.title: Zer
zer.note: It was a walled town of Naphtali, probably near the southwest shore of the Sea of Galilee, exact site unknown.

ziddim.title: Ziddim
ziddim.note: A walled town of Naphtali, listed with Hazor, Rakkath and Kinnereth. Some place it near the Sea of Galilee.

ziklag.title: Ziklag
ziklag.note: Achish of Gath gave this town in the Negev to David while he was running from Saul, and David lived there more than a year. Amalekites burned it while he was away and took the women and children, and he went after them and got everyone back.

zin.title: Zin
zin.note: The Wilderness of Zin, where Kadesh lay. Miriam died there, and there Moses struck the rock in anger when he had been told to speak to it.

zior.title: Zior
zior.note: In the hill country of Judah near Hebron, named once, and commonly identified with es-Sa'ir northeast of Hebron.

ziph.title: Ziph
ziph.note: David hid in the wilderness around Ziph, southeast of Hebron, while Saul was hunting him. The people of Ziph told Saul where he was, twice.

ziph-3.title: Ziph
ziph-3.note: Named once, in Joshua, and nowhere else.

zur-2.title: Zur
zur-2.about: King living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
zur-2.note: A Midianite chief killed in Israel's war against Midian. Phinehas had already killed his daughter Cozbi over the idolatry that brought the plague.
